meaning: Questioning competent persons; corroboration required for technical claims
Examination of approved documents, drawings, studies and records
Physical or logical examination of an asset, configuration or installation
Watching a process or activity being performed
Comparing two representations (for example design and as-built, register and discovered state) and resolving differences
Engineering or data analysis (calculation, trend, model, dependency graph)
Selecting a documented subset of a population for examination
Performing or witnessing a controlled test with defined initial state, method and expected result
Independently re-executing a procedure or calculation to confirm its result
Tabletop, simulation or live exercise of a defined scenario under authorisation
